name: Arita (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Arita town emblem in light blue, green and red: a light blue stylised bird with a green stroke and a red oval.
history: Municipal flag of Arita, a town in Saga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 2006.

features.role: Arita town emblem — a light blue stylised bird with a green stroke and a red oval
